name: MeasureTheory.HasPDF
type: {Ω E : Type*} → [MeasurableSpace E] → {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} → (Ω → E) → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → MeasureTheory.Measure E → Prop
provides: An almost-everywhere measurable random element has a density relative to a specified reference measure, through absolute continuity and a Lebesgue decomposition of its pushforward law.
type_review: Class and all three fields inspected with section parameters; the reference measure need not be volume and no bound on the density is included; manually expanded, not compiled.

name: Metric.coveringNumber
type: {X : Type*} → [PseudoEMetricSpace X] → ℝ≥0 → Set X → ℕ∞
provides: Minimum extended cardinality of a closed-radius cover whose centers lie inside the set being covered, retaining infinity when no finite cover exists.
type_review: Definition's infimum, internal-center restriction and IsCover closed-distance convention inspected with section parameters; manually expanded, not compiled.
